I’m One, or Leader, until we’re at the safe house. And it is so good to see you, Seven.”
'''Wraith One''' was the squadron callsign used by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Garik Loran]] during the time in which he led [[Wraith Squadron]] but [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], the Wraiths' commanding officer, retained use of the callsign [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]].

By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the Wraiths were reformed by Loran to prove the corrupt activities of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. [[Bhindi Drayson]], a veteran Wraith during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], was assigned to lead the team as Wraith One.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

Unbeknownst to Drayson's team, Loran also secretly formed a second unit of Wraiths to be led by another Wraith veteran [[Sharr Latt]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
